Sub: Intimation pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements), 
Regulations, 2015, regarding Q2 & HY1 FY27 Earnings Call - Audio recording of the call 
 
Dear Sir /Ma’am, 
 
Further to our letter dated October 23, 2026 and in compliance with Regulation 46(2) and Regulation 
30 read with Schedule III, Part A, Para A (15)(b) and other applicable provisions of the SEBI (Listing 
Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“SEBI Listing Regulations”), please note 
that the Audio recordings of Earnings Conference Call for the quarter and half year ended September 
30, 2026, held on Thursday, October 29, 2026, which concluded at 05:07 P.M.(IST), is available on the 
Company’s 
website 
under 
the 
following 
link: 
https://www.capriloans.in/cms/concall-
transcript/FY%202026%20-%202027/Quarter%20-2/Capri-Global-Capital-2QFY27-Earnings-Call.mp3  
The said intimation was received by the Company on October 29, 2026 at 07:21 P.M. (IST). 
 
This intimation is also being uploaded on the Company’s website at www.capriloans.in. 
 
The above is for your information and dissemination to all the stakeholders.   
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours faithfully, 
for Capri Global Capital Limited  
 
Yashesh Bhatt 
Company Secretary & Compliance Officer 
Membership No.: ACS 20491
